# API error codes

<!-- Generated from error.ProblemCode, error.ClientReaction and error.ImportRowCode by ErrorCodeCatalogueTest. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with
     cd backend && ./mvnw test -Dtest=ErrorCodeCatalogueTest -Derror-codes.write=true -->

Every error response is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body with a stable `code` (US-29-04, #374). A client branches on `code`, never on `detail`: `detail` is the server's English explanation for developers and logs. The app shows the text of the code's message key in the member's language; the keys and texts below are the server's own (`backend/src/main/resources/messages*.properties`).

Codes are part of the API contract, and an open set: new codes are added without a new API version, so a client handles a code it does not know by the response's HTTP status (an unknown row code: show its `message`). A code is never renamed; it is deprecated first and removed only as a declared breaking change, and a removed name is never used again ("Retired codes" below). The OpenAPI contract lists every code in `ApiProblem.code` (`x-extensible-enum`), and per operation the codes it can return (`x-problem-codes`, and one error response per status). `api/problem-codes.json` holds the same registry for the CI check that keeps these rules.

## Client reactions

| Reaction | What the client does |
|---|---|
| `FIX_INPUT` | Mark the rejected input, let the member correct it, then send the request again. |
| `SHOW` | Show the message; the same request fails again until the member changes something. |
| `RELOAD` | Reload the current state: it changed, and the request no longer applies to it. |
| `RELOAD_AND_RETRY` | Reload the resource, then retry with its new ETag in If-Match. |
| `RETRY` | Send the same request again right away. |
| `RETRY_LATER` | Retry the same request later, after Retry-After seconds when that header is sent. |
| `REAUTHENTICATE` | Refresh the access token or sign in again, then retry. |
| `REPORT` | Show a generic error and offer to report it, quoting the correlationId. |

## Import row codes

Not error responses: an import goes on, and each row or holdings line says in `error` or `warnings` (`ImportRowErrorResponse`: `code`, `args`, `message`) why it is not imported or what to check. `message` is already in the caller's language; the texts take the row's `args` in order as `{0}`, `{1}`, ...

| Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ROW_ERROR` | Row error: the row is not imported. |
| `ROW_SKIPPED` | Skipped: the row is shown, but never imported. |
| `ROW_WARNING` | Warning: the row stays included. |
| `HOLDINGS_LINE_ERROR` | Holdings line error: the line is not read. |
| `HOLDINGS_LINE_WARNING` | Holdings warning: shown, never blocking. |

| Code | Kind | Meaning | Message key | EN | DE |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IMPORT_ROW_ZERO_AMOUNT` | `ROW_SKIPPED` | A zero-amount booking that changes no balance. | `tmw.import.row.IMPORT_ROW_ZERO_AMOUNT` | This row has a zero amount and moves no money. It is shown but will not be imported. | Diese Zeile hat den Betrag null und verändert keinen Kontostand. Sie wird angezeigt, aber nicht importiert. |
| `IMPORT_ROW_FILTERED` | `ROW_SKIPPED` | The template's row filter does not accept the row's filter column value. | `tmw.import.row.IMPORT_ROW_FILTERED` | The value in this row’s filter column is not one the template accepts. It is shown but will not be imported. | Der Wert in der Filterspalte dieser Zeile ist keiner, den die Importvorlage zulässt. Sie wird angezeigt, aber nicht importiert. |
| `IMPORT_ROW_CAMT_NOT_BOOKED` | `ROW_SKIPPED` | A CAMT entry that is not booked (pending, information only); it comes back booked later. | `tmw.import.row.IMPORT_ROW_CAMT_NOT_BOOKED` | This entry has the status "{0}", not booked (BOOK); it is shown but will not be imported. | Dieser Eintrag hat den Status „{0}“, nicht gebucht (BOOK); er wird angezeigt, aber nicht importiert. |

| `IMPORT_ROW_VALUE_MISSING` | `ROW_ERROR` | A required cell is empty. | `tmw.import.row.IMPORT_ROW_VALUE_MISSING` | Column "{0}" is empty but required. | Spalte „{0}“ ist leer, wird aber benötigt. |
| `IMPORT_ROW_DATE_UNPARSEABLE` | `ROW_ERROR` | Not a date in the template's date format. | `tmw.import.row.IMPORT_ROW_DATE_UNPARSEABLE` | Column "{0}": "{1}" is not a date in the format {2}. | Spalte „{0}“: „{1}“ ist kein Datum im Format {2}. |
